taste.name: Photographs do the colouring
taste.trigger: When a flower shop needed a palette
taste.decision: Chose white text on black plus one red caption block and left every other hue to the photos, over coloured panels and gradients
taste.reason: Flowers are bought with the eyes, and any interface colour would compete with a petal
evidence: hero is one 1440x900 photo with type set directly on it

taste.name: One serif size, emphasis by italic
taste.trigger: When headlines, statements and list titles all needed a voice
taste.decision: Chose a condensed serif at a single 50px size with italic phrases over a six-step scale with bold
taste.reason: A condensed serif fits a full sentence into 3-5 lines at 50px, so the brand speaks in sentences instead of slogans, and the 13px mono beside it keeps it from turning into wedding stationery
evidence: VC Garamond Condensed weights 300 and 400 only
italic used for 2-4 words per headline

taste.name: The picture escapes its card
taste.trigger: When four use cases (home, office, gift, event) needed a section
taste.decision: Chose a 4686px pinned scene where each card's photo is repeated full-bleed and blurred behind it, over a four-card grid
taste.reason: One subject at full screen gives each use case its own mood; four cards side by side would have averaged them
evidence: card 330x400 over a 1440x800 enlargement of the same photo
cards slide sideways while backgrounds crossfade
caption blocks alternate red, black, white

taste.name: Navigation dissolved into the grid
taste.trigger: When the hero photo was supposed to reach the top edge
taste.decision: Chose to hang logo, socials, links and a catalogue thumbnail from the four column lines over a navbar strip
taste.reason: With no bar, the photograph owns the whole first screen. The cost is real: the stacked links collide with headlines mid-scroll
evidence: logo at x=10, socials at x=366, four links stacked at x=722, 175x110 thumbnail at x=1255
overlap with headlines visible at scroll positions 1164 and 3491
